decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the product list to identify actual backpacks, as the feed contained many accessories like stoves and sleeping pads. My consideration set includes a mix of high-capacity tactical packs (QT&QY and WINTMING), a technical daypack (KAILAS), an ultralight professional pack (Granite Gear), and a lifestyle team backpack (FOCO). I ultimately chose the QT&QY 45L Military Tactical Backpack because of its superior social proof—having a 4.7 rating from over 6,000 reviews—and its very competitive price of $39.99, which offers better value than the similar WINTMING model or the more expensive KAILAS hiking pack.
